download_blender_90M_model: download the Blender 90M model to a specified datapath using the download function
run_download_for_blender: run the download function to fetch the BST0B.tgz Blender 90M model archive
build_blender_model: build and download the Blender 90M model by calling build with a datapath and model type
check_blender_version: check the VERSION constant to confirm the Blender 90M model version is v1.0
review_download_function: review the download function to understand how it delegates to build for model retrieval
